invariants.rationale: The batch is needed to perform drawing; likely not null at method entry.
A non-null Drawable is required to invoke its draw method.
Width 'w' for a shape to be drawn is likely to be non-negative.
Height 'h' for a shape to be drawn is likely to be non-negative.
The right boundary (x + w) is greater than or equal to the left boundary (x) for non-negative widths.
